description: This file defines the MessageJavaCodeProducer class, which generates Java code related to IPC messaging, including interfaces, clients, and handlers based on message definitions within the project. It extends a base class MessageCodeProducer and uses templates to produce Java source files for IPC communication.

classes.name: MessageJavaCodeProducer
classes.description: Class responsible for generating Java IPC message code, including interface, client, and handler files based on message definitions and templates.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Main method to generate all IPC-related Java files for the project, including enums, interface, client, and handler.

methods.name: generateWrapperFile
methods.description: Stub method indicating wrapper files are not generated individually for each message.

methods.name: generateWrapperBuffer
methods.description: Stub method indicating wrapper buffer is not used.

methods.name: createIpcCodeInterface
methods.description: Creates the IPC Codes interface Java file based on message definitions.

methods.name: createIpcClient
methods.description: Creates the IPC client Java file to interact with IPC services.

methods.name: createIpcServiceHandler
methods.description: Creates the IPC service handler Java file that processes incoming IPC messages.

methods.name: getIpcCodesInterfaceName
methods.description: Constructs the name of the IPC Codes Java interface, optionally fully qualified.

methods.name: getIpcClientName
methods.description: Constructs the name of the IPC client Java class, optionally fully qualified.
